item.title: An Evening with Ingrid Miley - Women On Air
item.description: Please join us for ‘An Evening with Ingrid Miley’, a special Women On Air event around the theme of Women in the Workplace, on Wednesday 15 May. Join us for an evening with speaker Ingrid Miley, Industry and Employment Correspondent for RTÉ News. item.title: Women on Air calls for the funding of public media to be linked to achieving agreed gender balance targets on air - Women On Air
item.description: The Citizens’ Assembly on Gender Equality reconvenes this weekend and amongst the submissions the citizens will consider as part of its deliberations on the subject of ‘Women in Leadership’ is one from Women on Air.

item.title: Women on Air launches new ‘media database’ on Nollaig na mBan - Women On Air
item.description: Minister Catherine Martin encourages women to sign up and asks media outlets to do their part by involving more women guests. item.title: Women on Air with Mairead McGuinness
item.description: Women on Air are delighted to announce an evening at The Marker Hotel, Dublin with Mairead McGuinness. Outgoing European Commissioner for Financial Stability, Financial Services and Capital Markets Union, and the former First Vice President of the European Parliament, Mairead McGuiness has had a lengthy and varied career at the top level of the European Parliament.
